bio.content:
Born in the 90s, I grew up watching the internet transform from a technological novelty into a space for exploration, expression, and creation...

Today I am a web developer focused on UI and frontend, uniting programming, design, and my background as an artist to create visual, interactive, and expressive digital experiences.
